clean_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic California, 'Virtual Light' follows Berry Rydell, a former security officer turned bounty hunter, and Chevette Washington, a bicycle messenger who steals a pair of high-tech sunglasses. These sunglasses reveal valuable information that puts them in danger as they navigate a world where data is the ultimate currency. Their journey leads them to the heart of DatAmerica, exploring the intersections of technology and society.
